purpose: Provenance of the user-requested vector reference geometry. Generation uses the stored outlines; publication rights require separate review.

license.evidence: GitHub repository metadata reports license:null; no LICENSE or COPYING file is present at the repository root. Original attribution comments retained. Distribution permission is not established by this snapshot.

architecture.renderer: React SVG paths and groups; imperative requestAnimationFrame writes to transforms and eye opacity. No WebGL, Three.js, model downloads or sprite sheets in the bot renderer. Browser rendering/compositing may still use GPU.
architecture.animation: Procedural expressions, blinking, gaze, squash/stretch, hopping, breathing and idle motion in face.ts; mark.tsx consumes body transform, eye squash and opacity. SVG geometry is fixed; it does not reconstruct a rotating 3D mesh.
architecture.physics: pile.tsx uses matter-js for optional 2D collisions/dragging and procedural Web Audio bumps.
architecture.dependencies: Core: React, DOM/SVG and styles.module.css, with BotShape/BotColor types from data/bots.ts. Gallery/pile also require Next.js Link, matter-js, Section, Video, sounds and host theme CSS variables. Full upstream package.json retained for dependency provenance; dependencies not installed.
architecture.migration: Existing Bloom AvatarCharacter and authored 3D clips are not consumed by this implementation. Preserving current silhouettes, accessories and motion requires a separate adaptation/projection or baking design. Native needs a native renderer adaptation; the current implementation directly depends on DOM APIs.
architecture.validation: Original seven component files must match recorded Git blob hashes. This is source reference, not a runnable standalone app or a benchmark.
